title: 2021-22 Panini Prizm Red White & Blue Prizm #237 Darius Bazley Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This is a 2021-22 Panini Prizm trading card featuring Darius Bazley from the Oklahoma City Thunder. It is a Red White & Blue Prizm parallel/variety with card number 237. The card is part of the base set and includes features like the parallel/variety design. 

This card is perfect for basketball fans and collectors who are looking for a unique and high-quality sports trading card. It is an authentic and officially licensed item from Panini, a reputable manufacturer of sports memorabilia. Don't miss out on the chance to add this rare and valuable card to your collection.
